name: Echo state network of 50 variables (Dambre et al. 2012 parameterization)
question: Which functions of the input history do the 50 variables of the network represent?

provenance.source: J. Dambre, D. Verstraeten, B. Schrauwen and S. Massar, Sci. Rep. 2, 514 (2012), Eq. (11) and the text after it (N = 50; w_ij, v_i uniform on [-1, 1]; W rescaled to largest singular value 1; rho = 0.95 as in Fig. 2); the echo state network of H. Jaeger, GMD Report 148 (2001)

assumptions: the random instance (W, v) drawn with numpy default_rng(20120712); the source does not give its instance
the input enters the state of the same step, x_t = tanh(rho W x_{t-1} + v u_t) (Furuta's Eq. 17); Dambre's Eq. 11 shifts every delay by one
the input gain iota of Eq. (11) is the input amplitude: u uniform on [-iota, iota]
all 50 variables are measured (Dambre, Eq. 3 and Theorem 7)
